title: How I Made $32,000 in 30 Days Dropshipping With NO MONEY
summary: Creator reports a one-product dropshipping store built for near zero cost that reached five-figure monthly sales from organic short-form video.

assertions.quote: all that you need is just a laptop and Wi-Fi to get started
letting us go from zero to over $2,000 in just one day without running any paid ads at all
we were just recreating what was working on TI Tik Tok and we just put it on Instagram

verdicts.note: Cross-posting proven content raises the odds but virality stays largely luck-driven and the window closes as competitors copy.

assertions.quote: marketing is the biggest expense with Drop Shipping

verdicts.note: Ad spend is the largest line for most stores, but the margin shown omits payment fees, refunds, chargebacks, taxes and labour.

assertions.quote: might sound like you just need to be extremely lucky but honestly you just need the right strategy in place
the product needs to have already gone super viral and it's a product that people are already looking for
